description: This file contains an immutable implementation of the SubjectId interface, providing methods for creating, retrieving, and comparing subject identifier objects with issuer and subject components.

classes.name: ImmutableSubjectId
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the SubjectId interface representing a subject identifier composed of an issuer and a subject string.

methods.name: of (SubjectIssuer, CharSequence)
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectId instance from an issuer and a subject string, validating the input.

methods.name: of (CharSequence)
methods.description: Creates a new SubjectId instance from a combined issuer and subject string, parsing the components.

methods.name: getIssuer
methods.description: Returns the issuer component of the SubjectId.

methods.name: getSubject
methods.description: Returns the subject component of the SubjectId.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the length of the string representation of the SubjectId.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Returns the character at the specified index in the string representation.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Returns a subsequence of the string representation of the SubjectId.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another object based on issuer and subject.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes the hash code based on issuer and subject.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the SubjectId, combining issuer and subject with a delimiter if issuer is not empty.
